verdict.rationale: Google Workspace ships extensive official developer APIs/SDKs (Admin SDK, Reports API, Cloud Identity API, Apps Script) that developers can build against, but these are general admin/productivity APIs rather than AI-native tooling, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec to support AI-agent discovery/integration. missing for 10: AI-native SDK documentation, machine-readable OpenAPI/llms.txt for agent discovery, evidence of SDKs tailored to AI-native workflows.
